tools_json.title: JSON Formatter & Validator
tools_json.desc: Pretty-print JSON strings and check for syntax errors.
tools_json.usage_step1_desc: Paste a JSON string into the input field.
tools_json.usage_step2_desc: Toggle key sorting and adjust indentation (2 or 4 spaces).
tools_json.usage_step3_desc: Click ✨ Format to pretty-print, or 🗜️ Minify to remove whitespace.
tools_json.usage_step4_desc: Click 📋 Copy to save the formatted JSON to your clipboard.
tools_json.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: JSON is processed entirely in your browser. No data is sent to any server — safe for sensitive information.

tools_base64.title: Base64 Encoder / Decoder
tools_base64.desc: Easily convert between text and Base64. UTF-8 encoding is used.
tools_base64.usage_step1_desc: Type or paste text to encode or decode. Supports all UTF-8 characters including Korean, Japanese, and special symbols.
tools_base64.usage_step2_desc: Click 🔼 Encode to convert text to Base64, or 🔽 Decode to convert Base64 back to text.
tools_base64.usage_step3_desc: Click 📋 Copy to save to clipboard, or 🗑️ Clear to start over.
tools_base64.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: Base64 is commonly used for email attachments, data URIs, and API authentication tokens.

tools_url.title: URL Encoder / Decoder
tools_url.desc: Safely encode URLs containing non-ASCII characters.
tools_url.usage_step1_desc: Type or paste the URL or text you want to encode.
tools_url.usage_step2_desc: Click 🔼 Encode to percent-encode special characters, or 🔽 Decode to revert them.
tools_url.usage_step3_desc: Check the result and click 📋 Copy to save to your clipboard.
tools_url.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: URL encoding is essential when query parameters contain non-ASCII characters like Hangul or spaces.

tools_password.title: Secure Password Generator
tools_password.desc: Generate strong random passwords instantly. All processing happens in your browser.
tools_password.usage_step1_desc: Drag the slider to set the password length between 4 and 64 characters.
tools_password.usage_step2_desc: Check which character types to include: uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and/or symbols.
tools_password.usage_step3_desc: Click 🎲 Generate to create a password, check the strength indicator, then click 📋 Copy to save.
tools_password.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: Use 12+ characters with all character types for maximum security. Passwords are generated locally and never sent to any server.

tools_text_counter.title: Text Counter
tools_text_counter.desc: Count characters, words, bytes, and more in real time.
tools_text_counter.usage_step1_desc: Type or paste the text you want to analyze.
tools_text_counter.usage_step2_desc: All counts update in real time as you type: characters, words, lines, bytes, and sentences.
tools_text_counter.usage_step3_desc: Click 📋 Copy Text to copy the input, or 🗑️ Clear to reset.
tools_text_counter.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: Useful for social media posts (Twitter 280 chars, Instagram 2,200 chars), essays, and cover letters. Korean characters count as 3 bytes.

tools_color.title: Color Converter
tools_color.desc: Convert between HEX, RGB, and HSL color codes with live preview.
tools_color.usage_step1_desc: Use the color picker or enter a HEX code directly (e.g. #4f46e5).
tools_color.usage_step2_desc: RGB and HSL values are automatically calculated and displayed.
tools_color.usage_step3_desc: Click on any field to copy its value. Click 🎲 Random Color to generate a random color.
tools_color.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: HEX is the most common color format in web design, while RGB and HSL are frequently used in CSS for dynamic color manipulation.

tools_timestamp.title: Timestamp Converter
tools_timestamp.desc: Convert Unix timestamps (seconds/milliseconds) to readable dates.
tools_timestamp.usage_step1_desc: The current Unix timestamp and date/time update every second at the top.
tools_timestamp.usage_step2_desc: Paste a Unix timestamp and click 🔄 Convert. Seconds (10 digits) and milliseconds (13 digits) are auto-detected.
tools_timestamp.usage_step3_desc: Click ⏰ Use Current Time to instantly convert the current moment.
tools_timestamp.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: Unix timestamps count seconds (or milliseconds) since January 1, 1970 (UTC). Commonly used in APIs, log files, and databases.

tools_html.title: HTML Encoder / Decoder
tools_html.desc: Convert special characters to HTML entities (<, &, etc.) and back.
tools_html.usage_step1_desc: Type or paste text containing HTML special characters.
tools_html.usage_step2_desc: Click 🔼 HTML Encode to convert <, >, & to entities, or 🔽 HTML Decode to revert them.
tools_html.usage_step3_desc: Click 📋 Copy to save the encoded/decoded HTML to your clipboard.
tools_html.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: HTML encoding is essential for preventing XSS attacks and safely displaying user input on web pages.

tools_qr.title: QR Code Generator
tools_qr.desc: Convert URLs or text into scannable QR code images.
tools_qr.usage_step1_desc: Type the URL or text you want to convert into a QR code.
tools_qr.usage_step2_desc: Click 📱 Generate QR Code to instantly create the QR code image.
tools_qr.usage_step3_desc: Use your phone camera to scan the QR code, or click the download link to save the PNG image.
tools_qr.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: QR codes work reliably even with long URLs. Generated codes are permanent and never expire.

tools_case.title: Text Case Converter
tools_case.desc: Convert text to UPPER CASE, lower case, Capital Case, snake_case, camelCase and more.
tools_case.usage_step1_desc: Type or paste the text you want to convert.
tools_case.usage_step2_desc: Click the desired format button: UPPER CASE, lower case, Capital Case, snake_case, or camelCase.
tools_case.usage_step3_desc: Review the converted text and click 📋 Copy to save to your clipboard.
tools_case.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: snake_case is common in Python, camelCase in JavaScript. Capital Case is useful for titles and headings.

tools_uuid.title: UUID Generator
tools_uuid.usage_step1_desc: Enter how many UUIDs to generate (1 to 100).
tools_uuid.usage_step2_desc: Click 🎲 Generate UUIDs to create unique identifiers in v4 format.
tools_uuid.usage_step3_desc: Click 📋 Copy to save all generated UUIDs to your clipboard.
tools_uuid.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: UUIDs are used for database primary keys, API identifiers, session tokens, and any situation requiring unique values.

tools_hash.title: Text Hash Generator
tools_hash.desc: Generate SHA-256, SHA-1, and MD5 hashes in your browser. No data leaves your device.
tools_hash.usage_step1_desc: Type the text you want to hash. All hash values update in real time as you type.
tools_hash.usage_step2_desc: SHA-256 (recommended), SHA-1, and MD5 hashes are displayed simultaneously.
tools_hash.usage_step3_desc: Click the 📋 Copy button for any hash algorithm to save it to your clipboard. SHA-256 is the most secure.
tools_hash.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: Hash functions are used for password storage (with salt), file integrity verification, and digital signatures. SHA-256 is the current industry standard.
